name: plush-render-scoped-deferred-cleanup
instr:
Plush lacks render-scoped resource cleanup for helpers. Implement it consistently across interpreter and compiled execution, including nested scopes and abnormal exits, without changing rendering when cleanup is unused.

The `github.com/gobuffalo/plush/v5/helpers/hctx` package exposes `CleanupFunc func() error` and `CleanupContext interface { Context; DeferCleanup(CleanupFunc) error; CompleteCleanup() CleanupResult }`. Registration with a nil context or callback returns a defined error without panicking; registration after completion returns `ErrCleanupScopeClosed` with exact text `cleanup scope is closed`. Completion is concurrency-safe: accepted callbacks run exactly once in reverse order, panics become inspectable failures, and every completion observes equivalent results.

Child contexts inherit values but own independent registrations. Complete every owned helper-block, partial, layout, and top-level scope after evaluation and before its parent continues, from innermost to outermost, on success, render failure, budget exhaustion, or cancellation. Direct template, reader, and script execution complete only their own scopes. Preserve render failures while aggregating cleanup failures deterministically by unwind order, then reverse registration order.

Pooled VM partial scopes must not inherit parent ownership or retain callbacks or completion results after reuse. Linked VM partials and interpreter fallback unwind equivalent scope trees in lexical order, including frame err
